reasoning: For a fixed coloring each strip is an impartial game whose Grundy value at a cell is mex of the allowed previous one/two/three cell values, hence at most three. Retain the last three values; enumerate the finite reachable states from the first three cells, with an out-of-bounds sentinel excluded from mex. An uncolored cell sums three deterministic color transitions, including multiplicity when different colors lead to the same state. Binary-lift this transition matrix across arbitrarily long uncolored gaps and apply each specified color exactly at its real position. Matrix-vector and matrix-square operations use exact packed integer convolution with lanes wider than size*(MOD-1)^2, extracting only row dot products before modular reduction. Count the resulting final Grundy distribution for each strip, then XOR-convolve the four-value distributions; XOR zero is exactly a Bob win. Cache only identical length/fixed-color profiles. Minimize the reachable deterministic Moore machine before lifting: states with the same current Grundy output and indistinguishable next blocks under every color are merged to a fixed point. This preserves every future colored-word output and color multiplicity, reducing the measured 42-state example to 30. Aggregate initial prefix counts when several concrete states map to one block.
